generationPrompt: Create one production-quality realistic game VFX art sample for a modern shotgun muzzle discharge. Isolated effect only on a fully transparent background, no gun, no hands, no person, no environment, no text, no labels, no logo, no watermark, no border, no checkerboard. Side view: the exact muzzle attachment origin is at the left-center edge and the discharge travels horizontally to the right. Physically plausible short-duration smokeless-powder shotgun blast: compact white-hot core at the origin, broad irregular pale-yellow and amber pressure flame, a few sharp orange sparks, translucent expanding hot gas, and a restrained trailing gray-white smoke veil. Natural asymmetry and turbulent detail, photographic realism, high-frequency edge detail, high dynamic range, believable light falloff. Keep the main flash relatively short and wide rather than a long musket plume or an oversized cinematic fireball. The asset must read clearly when composited at a first-person shotgun muzzle in a dark industrial sci-fi interior. Preserve generous transparent padding around the full effect, especially above and below, and do not crop any sparks or smoke.
